generic.Defined scope/population: Every actuarial method run on the reserve segment for the current valuation quarter.
generic.In-scope period: All accident years shown in the segment triangle as at the current valuation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each method row carries a credibility rating, a weight and a written rationale.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Method count in the credibility grid equals the method count run in Milliman Arius.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Credibility grid saved with segment, valuation date and Arius run version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Methods excluded from selection are listed with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All methods scored for the segment plus the prior-quarter weight comparison.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any method run lacks a credibility rating or a weighting rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Unrated or disputed methods are escalated to the Chief Actuary before selection.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ratings and weights follow the documented segment maturity and volume criteria.
generic.Evidence location: Credibility grid filed with the segment reserve work papers for the valuation date.

steps.title: Export method indication results from Milliman Arius for the segment
sop: Open the segment project in Milliman Arius for the current valuation date.
Export the indication summary for every method run to Microsoft Excel.
Done when every method run for the segment appears in the export.
verify: Count the exported methods against the Arius method list.
Pass when the export shows every method run on the segment.

steps.title: Compile claim volume and count stability diagnostics in Microsoft Excel
sop: Pull claim counts and reported volume by accident year into the diagnostics tab.
Compute count stability and volume measures used to support credibility.
Done when volume and stability measures exist for every accident year.
verify: Check that no accident year in the triangle is missing a diagnostic value.
Pass when every accident year carries volume and stability measures.

steps.title: Score each method high, medium or low credibility in the Excel grid
sop: Score paid and incurred chain-ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Cape Cod and frequency-severity.
Record the volume and stability evidence supporting each score.
Done when every method carries a credibility score with supporting evidence.
verify: Inspect the grid for blank score or blank evidence cells.
Pass when no method row has a blank credibility score.

steps.title: Set method weights by accident year maturity in the Arius selection tab
sop: Weight chain-ladder for short-tail and mature accident years.
Weight Bornhuetter-Ferguson or expected loss ratio for immature accident years.
Done when weights are entered for every accident year and sum to one.
verify: Sum the weights per accident year in Milliman Arius.
Pass when weights sum to one for every accident year.

steps.title: Record excluded methods and exclusion reasons in the Excel work paper
sop: List every method excluded from the selection for this segment.
Write the reason for each exclusion such as thin data or distorted link ratios.
Done when each excluded method carries a written reason.
verify: Compare excluded methods to the Arius run list.
Pass when every excluded method has a documented reason.

steps.title: Compare weights to prior quarter in the Excel credibility exhibit
sop: Load the prior-quarter credibility grid and align it beside the current grid.
Explain in writing every method whose weight has shifted.
Done when each weight shift carries a written explanation.
verify: Scan the comparison column for unexplained shifts.
Pass when no weight shift is left without explanation.

steps.title: Obtain Chief Actuary review of the credibility conclusion
sop: Walk the Chief Actuary through the scores, weights and exclusions for the segment.
Capture challenge points and update the grid where required.
Done when the Chief Actuary confirms the credibility conclusion.
verify: Check the grid for the reviewer name and review date.
Pass when the reviewed grid carries the Chief Actuary name and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: IBNR for every accident year and reserve segment in the current valuation.
generic.In-scope period: All accident years in the triangle as at the current valuation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Selected ultimate, paid loss and case reserve are present for every cell.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Segment IBNR totals sum to the IBNR control total on the reserve exhibit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: IBNR calculation saved with valuation date and the Arius run identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Negative IBNR cells are listed with a documented explanation or corrected.
generic.Test population: Every accident year and segment IBNR cell on gross and net bases.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any negative IBNR cell lacks a rationale or the totals do not tie.
generic.Exception handling path: Negative or anomalous IBNR is investigated and escalated to the Reserving Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: IBNR equals selected ultimate less paid loss less case reserve for every cell.
generic.Evidence location: IBNR exhibit filed in the segment reserve work paper pack for the quarter.

steps.title: Load selected ultimates, paid loss and case reserves into Milliman Arius
sop: Confirm the Arius project holds the approved selected ultimates for the segment.
Load the latest paid loss and case reserve diagonal for the valuation date.
Done when ultimates, paid and case data are loaded for every accident year.
verify: Compare the loaded diagonal to the validated claims extract totals.
Pass when the loaded paid and case totals match the extract.

steps.title: Compute IBNR per accident year and segment in Milliman Arius
sop: Run the IBNR calculation as selected ultimate less paid loss less case reserve.
Produce the IBNR result for every accident year and segment.
Done when an IBNR value exists for every accident year and segment.
verify: Scan the IBNR grid for blank cells.
Pass when no accident year and segment cell is blank.

steps.title: Split IBNR into pure IBNR and case development in Microsoft Excel
sop: Identify segments where the pure IBNR and IBNER split is required.
Compute the split using the reported claim count development pattern.
Done when the split is produced for every segment that requires it.
verify: Add pure IBNR and IBNER back to total IBNR per segment.
Pass when the components sum to total IBNR for every segment.

steps.title: Review negative IBNR cells in the Excel exception listing
sop: List every accident year and segment cell showing negative IBNR.
Investigate each cell and record the explanation or correct the selection.
Done when every negative cell is explained or corrected.
verify: Filter the IBNR grid for values below zero.
Pass when each remaining negative cell carries a documented rationale.

steps.title: Compute gross and net IBNR in Milliman Arius
sop: Run the IBNR calculation on both gross and net of reinsurance bases.
Compare gross to net for every accident year and segment.
Done when gross and net IBNR are produced for every segment.
verify: Test that gross IBNR is greater than or equal to net IBNR everywhere.
Pass when no segment shows net IBNR above gross IBNR.

steps.title: Tie total IBNR to the reserve summary exhibit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Sum segment-level IBNR and compare it to the summary exhibit control total.
Investigate and clear any difference before releasing the figure.
Done when the segment sum equals the summary control total.
verify: Recompute the difference between the segment sum and the control total.
Pass when the difference is zero.

generic.Defined scope/population: Selected ultimates for every accident year and segment against the prior quarter.
generic.In-scope period: Current valuation quarter compared with the signed prior-quarter selections.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Prior and current ultimate, dollar change and percentage change per accident year.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Prior-quarter ultimates in the exhibit tie to the signed prior reserve exhibit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Comparison exhibit saved with both valuation dates and the Arius run version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accident years above the movement threshold carry a written explanation.
generic.Test population: Every accident year and segment appearing in either quarter selection.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any accident year over the materiality threshold has no explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained movements are referred back to the Actuarial Analyst for analysis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Movement split between actual-versus-expected emergence and selection change.
generic.Evidence location: Prior-versus-current comparison exhibit in the quarterly reserve work papers.

steps.title: Retrieve prior-quarter signed selections from the reserve exhibit archive
sop: Open the signed prior-quarter reserve exhibit for the segment.
Extract selected ultimates by accident year into Microsoft Excel.
Done when prior selections are loaded for every accident year.
verify: Compare the extracted values to the signed prior exhibit line by line.
Pass when every prior selection matches the signed exhibit.

steps.title: Export current selected ultimates from Milliman Arius
sop: Export the current selected ultimate by accident year and segment from Arius.
Load the export into the comparison workbook.
Done when current selections are loaded for every accident year.
verify: Compare the export total to the current Arius selection summary.
Pass when the export total equals the Arius selection total.

steps.title: Build the prior-versus-current exhibit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Align prior and current ultimates by accident year and segment.
Compute the dollar change and the percentage change for each row.
Done when every accident year row shows both change measures.
verify: Check the exhibit for rows missing a change calculation.
Pass when every accident year row carries a dollar and percentage change.

steps.title: Flag accident years above the movement threshold in the Excel exhibit
sop: Apply the agreed materiality threshold to the change columns.
Flag every accident year and segment breaching the threshold.
Done when all breaching rows are flagged for explanation.
verify: Re-apply the threshold filter to the exhibit.
Pass when every row above threshold carries a flag.

steps.title: Split the movement into emergence and selection change in Milliman Arius
sop: Compute expected emergence for the quarter from the prior selections.
Split each movement between actual-versus-expected emergence and selection change.
Done when the two components sum to the total movement per accident year.
verify: Add the two components and compare to the total movement.
Pass when the components sum to the total movement for every row.

steps.title: Write movement explanations into the Excel comparison exhibit
sop: Write an explanation for each flagged accident year and segment.
Reference the driver such as large loss, factor change or method change.
Done when every flagged row carries a written explanation.
verify: Filter the exhibit for flagged rows with a blank explanation.
Pass when no flagged row has a blank explanation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid and incurred triangles for every reserve segment in the valuation.
generic.In-scope period: All accident years and development ages in the approved triangle horizon.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Accident year, development age, paid loss and case-incurred are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Latest diagonal totals equal paid and incurred totals in the claims extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Triangle file saved with valuation date and the source extract identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Blank or zero cells inside the populated region are logged and resolved.
generic.Test population: Every populated cell of the paid, incurred, count and severity triangles.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the latest diagonal does not reconcile to the warehouse extract.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing cells are traced to dropped transactions and reloaded before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Grouping and segmentation match the approved reserve segmentation basis.
generic.Evidence location: Triangle pack stored with the segment reserve work papers for the quarter.

steps.title: Load the validated claims extract into Milliman Arius
sop: Take the reconciled claims extract from the enterprise data warehouse.
Load it into the Arius project for the current valuation date.
Done when the extract loads without rejected records.
verify: Review the Arius load log for rejected or skipped rows.
Pass when the load log shows no rejected records.

steps.title: Build paid and incurred triangles by accident year in Milliman Arius
sop: Build the paid loss triangle by accident year and development age per segment.
Build the case-incurred triangle on the same grouping.
Done when both triangles exist for every reserve segment.
verify: Check that each segment has a paid and an incurred triangle.
Pass when no segment is missing either triangle.

steps.title: Confirm the triangle grouping matches the approved segmentation
sop: Compare the triangle grouping to the approved segmentation document.
Confirm the annual or quarterly development basis is as approved.
Done when the grouping is confirmed against the approved basis.
verify: Re-read the segmentation document against the Arius setup.
Pass when grouping and segmentation match the approved basis.

steps.title: Reconcile the latest diagonal to the claims warehouse extract
sop: Sum the latest diagonal paid and incurred amounts per segment.
Compare the sums to the claims data warehouse extract control totals.
Done when the diagonal agrees to the extract for every segment.
verify: Recompute the difference between diagonal and extract totals.
Pass when the difference is zero for every segment.

steps.title: Scan the triangle for missing or zero cells in Milliman Arius
sop: Scan the populated triangle region for blank or zero development cells.
Trace each anomaly to dropped claim transactions in the claims management platform.
Done when every anomalous cell is explained or the data is reloaded.
verify: Re-scan the populated region after correction.
Pass when no unexplained blank cell remains inside the populated region.

steps.title: Build claim count and average severity triangles in Milliman Arius
sop: Build reported and closed claim count triangles on the same segmentation.
Derive the average severity triangle from incurred and count triangles.
Done when count and severity triangles exist for every segment.
verify: Recompute severity as incurred divided by counts for a sample of cells.
Pass when the recomputed severity matches the triangle values.

steps.title: File the triangle pack in the segment reserve work papers
sop: Export the triangle pack with segment, valuation date and extract reference.
Store it in the quarterly reserve work paper folder.
Done when the labelled triangle pack is filed.
verify: Open the filed pack and check the labelling.
Pass when the pack shows segment, valuation date and extract reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ultimate loss indications for every accident year and reserve segment.
generic.In-scope period: All accident years in the segment triangle at the current valuation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each method result carries accident year, segment and ultimate loss amount.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Method indication counts match the methods scheduled to run per segment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Indication exhibit saved with the Arius run identifier and valuation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Methods that fail to run or produce distorted results are logged and resolved.
generic.Test population: Every accident year and segment on the side-by-side indication exhibit.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if fewer than three independent methods appear for any accident year.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed or distorted method runs are escalated to the Reserving Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A-priori loss ratios agree to the plan loss ratios supplied by Pricing.
generic.Evidence location: Indication exhibit filed in the quarterly segment reserve work papers.

steps.title: Run paid and incurred chain-ladder ultimates in Milliman Arius
sop: Apply the selected development factors to the paid and incurred triangles.
Run chain-ladder ultimates for every accident year and segment.
Done when both chain-ladder indications are produced for every segment.
verify: Check the Arius output for accident years missing an indication.
Pass when both chain-ladder methods return an ultimate for every accident year.

steps.title: Load a-priori loss ratios from Pricing into Milliman Arius
sop: Obtain the current plan and pricing loss ratios by segment from Pricing.
Load them into the Arius expected loss ratio assumption set.
Done when an a-priori ratio is loaded for every segment.
verify: Compare loaded ratios to the Pricing source file line by line.
Pass when every loaded a-priori ratio matches the Pricing source.

steps.title: Run Bornhuetter-Ferguson and expected loss ratio methods in Milliman Arius
sop: Run the Bornhuetter-Ferguson method using the loaded a-priori ratios.
Run the expected loss ratio method on the same basis.
Done when both indications are produced for every accident year.
verify: Scan the output grid for missing Bornhuetter-Ferguson or expected loss ratio results.
Pass when both methods return values for every accident year.

steps.title: Run the frequency-severity method for long-tail segments in Milliman Arius
sop: Identify long-tail segments with credible claim counts.
Run frequency-severity ultimates using the count and severity triangles.
Done when the method has run for every credible long-tail segment.
verify: List long-tail segments and check for a frequency-severity result.
Pass when every credible long-tail segment carries a result.

steps.title: Build the side-by-side indication exhibit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Export all method ultimates from Arius into the indication workbook.
Lay the methods side by side per accident year and segment.
Done when every method ultimate appears on the exhibit.
verify: Count methods shown per accident year on the exhibit.
Pass when at least three independent methods appear for every accident year.

steps.title: Review method indications for distortion in the Excel exhibit
sop: Review indications for outliers caused by thin data or distorted factors.
Log distorted results with the reason and the treatment applied.
Done when every distorted indication is logged with a treatment.
verify: Filter the exhibit for flagged distorted results.
Pass when each flagged result carries a documented treatment.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reserve exhibit and work papers for every segment in the valuation.
generic.In-scope period: The current valuation quarter for all in-scope reserve segments.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each exhibit shows segment, valuation date, preparer and reviewer initials.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibit selections agree to the booked reserve summary control totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Work paper pack versioned in SharePoint with the Arius run identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known data limitations are recorded with their impact on the estimate.
generic.Test population: Every segment exhibit in the valuation work paper pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any segment lacks a complete exhibit or a named reviewer.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete exhibits are returned to the preparer before the pack is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exhibit contains data, triangles, factors, indications and final selections.
generic.Evidence location: Reserve work paper pack in the Microsoft 365 SharePoint valuation library.

steps.title: Export data, triangle and factor exhibits from Milliman Arius
sop: Export the data summary, triangles and selected factor exhibits per segment.
Save the exports into the segment work paper workbook.
Done when every segment has data, triangle and factor exhibits exported.
verify: Check each segment folder for the three exhibit types.
Pass when no segment is missing a data, triangle or factor exhibit.

steps.title: Assemble the method indication and selection exhibits in Microsoft Excel
sop: Add the method indication and final selection exhibits to each segment workbook.
Confirm the selections shown match the approved Arius selections.
Done when indication and selection exhibits are present for every segment.
verify: Compare a sample of exhibit selections to the Arius selection tab.
Pass when the sampled selections match Arius exactly.

steps.title: Document the selection rationale and method weights in the Excel exhibit
sop: Write the rationale for each selection including the method weights applied.
Cross-reference the rationale to the credibility grid for the segment.
Done when every segment selection carries a written rationale.
verify: Scan the rationale column for blank entries.
Pass when no segment selection is missing its rationale.

steps.title: Record data limitations and their reserve impact in the work papers
sop: List the known data limitations affecting the valuation.
State the estimated impact of each limitation on the reserve estimate.
Done when each limitation carries a stated impact.
verify: Review the limitations list for entries with no impact statement.
Pass when every limitation carries an impact statement.

steps.title: Attach the claims data reconciliation to the work paper pack
sop: Take the signed claims extract reconciliation for the valuation date.
Attach it to the reserve work paper pack as a supporting exhibit.
Done when the reconciliation is attached and referenced in the index.
verify: Open the pack index and follow the reconciliation reference.
Pass when the referenced reconciliation opens from the pack.

steps.title: Label every exhibit and file the pack in Microsoft 365 SharePoint
sop: Label each exhibit with segment, valuation date and preparer initials.
Upload the pack to the SharePoint valuation library for the quarter.
Done when the labelled pack is filed in the quarterly library.
verify: Open a sample of exhibits from SharePoint and check the labelling.
Pass when every sampled exhibit shows segment, date and preparer.

steps.title: Obtain Chief Actuary review sign-off on the reserve exhibit pack
sop: Review the assembled pack for completeness against the exhibit checklist.
Record reviewer initials and review date on each segment exhibit.
Done when the pack carries reviewer initials for every segment.
verify: Check every segment exhibit for reviewer initials and date.
Pass when no segment exhibit lacks a named reviewer and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Material quarter-over-quarter reserve movements for every segment.
generic.In-scope period: Movement between the prior signed valuation and the current valuation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each driver row carries a category, a dollar impact and a narrative.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Driver amounts sum to the total quarter-over-quarter reserve movement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Driver analysis saved with both valuation dates and the Arius run version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unattributed residual movement is logged and investigated before sign-off.
generic.Test population: Every segment showing a movement above the materiality threshold.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if driver amounts do not sum to the total movement per segment.
generic.Exception handling path: Residual differences are referred to the Actuarial Analyst for re-attribution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Drivers use the agreed categories and name the claims or segments involved.
generic.Evidence location: Change driver analysis filed with the quarterly reserve work papers.

steps.title: Load the quarter movement exhibit from Milliman Arius
sop: Export the prior-versus-current movement by accident year and segment.
Load the export into the driver analysis workbook in Microsoft Excel.
Done when the movement is loaded for every segment.
verify: Compare the loaded total to the Arius movement summary.
Pass when the loaded total equals the Arius movement total.

steps.title: Attribute each movement to a driver category in Microsoft Excel
sop: Assign each movement to emergence, factor change, method change, data or large loss.
Record the narrative supporting each attribution.
Done when every material movement carries a driver category.
verify: Filter for material movements with no driver category.
Pass when every material movement has a category assigned.

steps.title: Quantify the dollar impact of each driver in the Excel workbook
sop: Compute the dollar impact attributable to each driver per segment.
Compare the sum of drivers to the total movement for the segment.
Done when driver amounts sum to the total movement.
verify: Recompute the residual between driver sum and total movement.
Pass when the residual is zero for every segment.

steps.title: Name the large claims driving development in Milliman Arius
sop: Identify the individual claims or claim groups causing adverse or favourable movement.
Record claim references and amounts against the relevant driver rows.
Done when each large-loss driver names its underlying claims.
verify: Trace a sample of named claims back to the claims data.
Pass when the sampled claim amounts agree to the claims data.

steps.title: Cross-reference method and weight changes to their approvals
sop: List method or weighting changes contributing to the movement.
Reference the approval record for each change in the driver workbook.
Done when every method or weight change cites its approval.
verify: Follow each approval reference to the approval record.
Pass when every referenced approval is found and dated.

steps.title: Carry driver commentary into the management summary in Microsoft Excel
sop: Summarise the drivers by segment into the management summary section.
Confirm the summary amounts match the detailed driver workbook.
Done when the management summary reflects every material driver.
verify: Compare summary amounts to the detailed driver totals.
Pass when the summary and detail amounts agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims transactions for all reserve segments and accident years in scope.
generic.In-scope period: All accident years in scope as at the stated valuation date cut-off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim status, line of business and accident date are populated on every record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extract row count and paid and case totals are logged for reconciliation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract file saved with the job run identifier and valuation date parameter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Test claims and duplicate transaction rows are logged and removed.
generic.Test population: Every record in the reserving extract for the valuation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the extract job errors or test claim identifiers remain present.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed or partial extracts are rerun and the prior file is superseded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Extract covers paid loss, paid ALAE, case reserves, counts and recoveries.
generic.Evidence location: Extract file and job log stored in the reserving data folder for the quarter.

steps.title: Set the valuation date parameter on the reserving extract job
sop: Open the reserving extract job in the enterprise data warehouse.
Set the valuation date, accident year range and segment scope parameters.
Done when the parameters match the approved valuation scope.
verify: Re-read the saved job parameters before execution.
Pass when the parameters equal the approved valuation scope.

steps.title: Run the extract for paid, case, counts and recoveries in the data warehouse
sop: Execute the extract job against the claims data warehouse tables.
Capture paid loss, paid ALAE, case reserves, claim counts and recoveries.
Done when the job completes with a success status.
verify: Read the job log for the completion status and record count.
Pass when the log shows successful completion with the valuation date recorded.

steps.title: Confirm segment and accident year coverage in the extract
sop: List distinct reserve segments and accident years present in the extract.
Compare the list to the approved valuation scope.
Done when every in-scope segment and accident year is present.
verify: Difference the extract list against the approved scope list.
Pass when no in-scope segment or accident year is missing.

steps.title: Validate key claim fields in the extract against the claims platform
sop: Test claim status, line of business and accident date for null or invalid values.
List failing records for correction in the claims management platform.
Done when every record carries valid status, line and accident date.
verify: Re-run the field validation after correction.
Pass when the validation returns no failing records.

steps.title: Remove test claims and duplicate transactions from the extract
sop: Screen the extract for test or dummy claim identifiers and duplicate rows.
Remove them and log the removals with the reason.
Done when no test identifier or duplicate row remains.
verify: Re-screen the extract for test identifiers and duplicate keys.
Pass when the screen returns no test claims and no duplicates.

steps.title: Log extract row count and control totals in the data warehouse folder
sop: Record the final row count and the paid, case and count control totals.
Store the control totals with the extract for the reconciliation step.
Done when the control totals are recorded alongside the extract.
verify: Recompute the control totals from the extract file.
Pass when the recomputed totals match the logged totals.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reserve journal entries for case, IBNR and LAE movements by segment.
generic.In-scope period: The current financial close period for all reporting legal entities.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entry line carries account, legal entity, segment and amount.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Posted GL reserve balance agrees to the actuarial reserve summary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: GL document number and posting timestamp retained with the entry support.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Posting rejections and reconciling differences are logged and cleared.
generic.Test population: Every reserve journal entry posted for the close period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an entry posts without independent approval or the GL does not tie.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected or unbalanced entries are corrected and reposted before close.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entry maps to approved reserve accounts and posts within the close deadline.
generic.Evidence location: Entry support and GL document reference filed in the close folder.

steps.title: Build the reserve movement schedule by segment in Microsoft Excel
sop: Take the booked reserve summary and compute the movement by segment.
Split the movement between case, IBNR and LAE reserve components.
Done when the movement schedule is complete for every segment.
verify: Sum the schedule and compare to the total reserve movement.
Pass when the schedule sum equals the total reserve movement.

steps.title: Map each movement line to GL reserve accounts in the ERP
sop: Map each reserve component to its GL account and legal entity company code.
Confirm the mapping against the approved chart of accounts.
Done when every movement line carries an account and company code.
verify: Check the mapped accounts against the approved chart of accounts.
Pass when every mapped account is valid for the company code.

steps.title: Prepare the journal entry in the ERP general ledger
sop: Enter the reserve journal lines into the ERP general ledger for the period.
Attach the movement schedule as the supporting documentation.
Done when the entry is prepared and balanced with support attached.
verify: Check the entry debits and credits in the ERP.
Pass when the entry balances and carries attached support.

steps.title: Obtain independent approver sign-off in the ERP workflow
sop: Route the entry for independent approval in the ERP approval workflow.
Confirm the approver is different from the preparer.
Done when the entry carries a recorded independent approval.
verify: Read the ERP approval history for the entry.
Pass when preparer and approver identities differ and are recorded.

steps.title: Post the entry in the ERP and record the GL document number
sop: Post the approved entry within the close calendar deadline.
Record the GL document number against the reserve work papers.
Done when the entry is posted and the document number is recorded.
verify: Look up the document number in the ERP and check the posting date.
Pass when the posting date falls within the close deadline.

steps.title: Reconcile the posted GL reserve balance to the actuarial summary
sop: Extract the posted GL reserve balances by account and segment.
Compare them to the actuarial reserve summary and clear differences.
Done when the GL balance equals the actuarial summary by segment.
verify: Recompute the GL to actuarial difference by segment.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reserve indications and drivers for every segment presented for booking.
generic.In-scope period: The current valuation quarter ahead of the reserve booking deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack shows selected ultimates, IBNR, range and movement for each segment.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pack totals agree to the Arius selection summary for the valuation date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Meeting pack and notes saved in SharePoint with the meeting date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments held for rework are logged with the required action and owner.
generic.Test population: Every segment included in the indication pack for the quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a segment is booked without a recorded approval decision.
generic.Exception handling path: Challenged selections return to the Reserving Actuary before booking.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notes record attendees, decisions on selections and follow-up actions.
generic.Evidence location: Meeting pack and notes in the SharePoint quarterly reserve review folder.

steps.title: Build the indication pack by segment in Microsoft Excel
sop: Assemble selected ultimates, IBNR, range and quarter movement per segment.
Add the driver commentary for material movements.
Done when the pack covers every segment presented for booking.
verify: Compare pack totals to the reserve selection summary.
Pass when pack totals equal the selection summary totals.

steps.title: Highlight segments outside the reasonable range in the Excel pack
sop: Compare each selection to the calculated range of reasonable estimates.
Highlight segments sitting outside the range with the supporting rationale.
Done when every out-of-range segment is highlighted with a rationale.
verify: Re-test each selection against its range.
Pass when every out-of-range segment appears highlighted in the pack.

steps.title: Circulate the pack through Microsoft 365 SharePoint before the review
sop: Upload the pack to the quarterly reserve review folder in SharePoint.
Notify attendees with the meeting date and reading deadline.
Done when the pack is circulated ahead of the review.
verify: Check the SharePoint upload timestamp against the meeting date.
Pass when the pack was circulated before the meeting.

steps.title: Walk the Chief Actuary through indications and drivers
sop: Present selected ultimates, IBNR and movement drivers segment by segment.
Explain any segment outside the reasonable range.
Done when every segment has been presented and discussed.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ratio analysis published with the valuation date and data refresh time.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ratios outside the expected band are logged with an investigation note.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ratio conclusions are carried into the reserve adequacy write-up.

steps.title: Compute the reserve adequacy ratios by line in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute paid-to-incurred, reserve-to-premium and reserve-to-surplus ratios.
Add the survival ratio for long-tail lines.
Done when every ratio is computed for every line.
verify: Scan the ratio table for blank values.
Pass when every line carries all required ratios.

steps.title: Trend each ratio over the last eight to twelve quarters
sop: Build the quarterly trend series for each ratio and line.
Flag directional shifts in the trend.
Done when every ratio carries a quarterly trend series.
verify: Check each series for missing quarters.
Pass when every series covers the required quarters.

steps.title: Compare ratios to industry benchmarks where available
sop: Load available industry benchmarks for each line.
Compare the company ratios to the benchmark values.
Done when benchmarks are compared where available.
verify: Check that each benchmarked line shows a comparison.
Pass when every available benchmark is compared.

steps.title: Investigate ratios outside the expected band
sop: Identify ratios outside the expected band for the line.
Investigate and document the cause for each.
Done when every outlier ratio carries an investigation note.
verify: Filter the analysis for outliers with no note.
Pass when every outlier carries an investigation note.

steps.title: Publish the ratio dashboard to the BI reporting platform
sop: Publish the trended ratios and flags to the BI reporting platform.
Confirm the published values match the source workbook.
Done when the dashboard is published.
verify: Compare published values to the source workbook.
Pass when the published values match the workbook.

steps.title: Carry the ratio conclusions into the adequacy write-up
sop: Summarise the ratio conclusions for the reserve adequacy write-up.
Confirm the summary reflects the flagged outliers.
Done when the conclusions are carried into the write-up.
verify: Compare the write-up conclusions to the flagged outliers.
Pass when every flagged outlier is addressed in the write-up.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risk of material adverse deviation analysis for the opinion year.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risk factors not quantified are logged with the reason.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Risk factors for disclosure are identified for the relevant comment section.
generic.Evidence location: RMAD work paper in the opinion year documentation pack.

steps.title: Set and document the materiality standard in Microsoft Excel
sop: Set the materiality standard for the RMAD assessment.
Document the basis for the standard chosen.
Done when the standard and its basis are documented.
verify: Compare the standard to the prior opinion year basis.
Pass when the standard and basis are documented.

steps.title: Identify major risk factors by line in the RMAD work paper
sop: Identify the risk factors that could produce material adverse deviation.
Record the factors by line of business.
Done when every line carries its identified risk factors.
verify: Scan the work paper for lines with no risk factors.
Pass when every line carries identified risk factors.

steps.title: Quantify potential deviation using the range analysis in Milliman Arius
sop: Use the reserve variability or range analysis to quantify potential deviation.
Record the deviation amount by line and in total.
Done when the deviation is quantified for every line.
verify: Compare the quantification to the range analysis output.
Pass when the quantification ties to the range analysis.

steps.title: Compare the deviation to the materiality standard
sop: Compare the quantified deviation to the materiality standard.
Record whether the standard is exceeded.
Done when the comparison is recorded for every line.
verify: Recompute the comparison against the standard.
Pass when the comparison result is recorded for every line.

steps.title: State the RMAD conclusion in the work paper
sop: State the RMAD conclusion for the opinion year.
Confirm the conclusion follows from the quantified comparison.
Done when the RMAD conclusion is stated.
verify: Read the conclusion against the comparison results.
Pass when the conclusion follows from the comparison.

steps.title: Document risk factors for the relevant comment disclosure
sop: Select the risk factors requiring disclosure in the opinion comments.
Draft the disclosure wording for each factor.
Done when the disclosure factors are documented.
verify: Compare the documented factors to the identified risk factor list.
Pass when every disclosable factor is documented.

steps.title: Tag the archive with period, treaty year and preparer

verify: Read the archive metadata tags.
Pass when all three tags are present and correct.

steps.title: Upload the archive to the compliance evidence repository
sop: Upload the tagged archive to the compliance evidence repository.

Done when the full archive is uploaded.

steps.title: Apply retention period and legal-hold flag to the archive

Record the retrieval result against the response requirement.

verify: Compare the retrieval time to the required response time.

Record the provision recommendation arising from the conclusion.
Done when every reinsurer carries a conclusion and recommendation.
verify: Filter the schedule for missing conclusions.
Pass when every reinsurer carries a conclusion and recommendation.

steps.title: Load treaty terms from the reinsurance administration system

Correct any layer where the ceded reserve exceeds the limit.

verify: Re-run the limit test across all layers.

steps.title: Reconcile net reserves to gross less ceded
sop: Compute net reserves as gross less ceded by segment and accident year.
Investigate and clear any difference to the booked net reserves.
Done when the identity holds for every segment and accident year.
verify: Recompute gross less ceded against net for every row.

verify: Compare the valuation to the ceded reserve calculation.

steps.title: Produce discounted and undiscounted valuations for comparison
sop: Produce the undiscounted actuarial estimate for the commuted reserves.
Produce the discounted estimate on the agreed discount basis.

steps.title: Compare the commutation offer to the actuarial estimates
sop: Load the reinsurer commutation offer from the treaty file.
Compare the offer to both actuarial estimates.

steps.title: Quantify the reserve release and profit impact
sop: Quantify the reserve release arising from the commutation.
Quantify the profit or loss impact for the reporting period.
Done when both impacts are quantified.
verify: Recompute the impacts from the offer and the reserve valuation.
Pass when the recomputation matches the quantification.

steps.title: Agree the negotiating position and walk-away value
sop: Agree the target and walk-away values with Reinsurance and Finance.
Record the agreed position in the commutation file.
Done when the negotiating position is agreed and recorded.
verify: Read the recorded position against the actuarial valuation.
Pass when the position is recorded with its supporting valuation.

steps.title: Record the approval required before execution
sop: Identify the approval authority required for the commutation.
Record the required approval and its status in the commutation file.
Done when the required approval is recorded.
verify: Read the approval record before execution.
Pass when the required approval is recorded and in place.

steps.title: Query open claims with reinsurance attachments in the claims platform

Identify claims carrying treaty or facultative coverage attachments.
Done when the reinsured open claim listing is produced.
verify: Compare the listing count to the open claim population.
Pass when the listing is drawn from the full open claim population.

steps.title: Validate treaty year and treaty code on each claim
sop: Check the treaty year and treaty code on each identified claim.
List claims with missing or invalid treaty references.

sop: Compare incurred amounts to the treaty attachment points.

sop: List claims above an attachment point with no reinsurance attachment.

sop: Compare the reinsured claim listing to the reinsurance system claim records.

sop: Review the listing, flags and exception resolutions.
Record the release of the listing for the ceded calculation.

verify: Compare the uncovered list to the reinsurance programme design.

sop: Version the mapping file in the treaty repository.

verify: Scan the report for balances with no collection status.
Pass when every balance carries a status and ageing bucket.

steps.title: Publish the collection status dashboard to the BI platform
sop: Publish the ageing and collection status to the BI reporting platform.

generic.In-scope period: The current reporting quarter with prior-quarter comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, ceded case, ceded IBNR and recoverable populated per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported ceded balances agree to the ledger and the reinsurance system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report versioned in SharePoint with the reporting quarter and preparer.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances failing to reconcile are logged and cleared before issue.
generic.Test population: Every treaty carrying ceded reserves in the reporting quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the reported ceded balances do not agree to the general ledger.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled balances are held back until cleared.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report includes movement commentary and the bad-debt provision summary.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint quarterly ceded reserve report folder with the BI dashboard.

steps.title: Assemble ceded case, IBNR and recoverable by treaty in Microsoft Excel
sop: Assemble the ceded case, IBNR and recoverable balances by treaty.
Tie the balances to the ceded reserve calculation.
Done when every treaty balance is assembled.
verify: Compare the assembled totals to the ceded calculation.
Pass when the totals agree to the ceded calculation.

steps.title: Add quarter movement and driver commentary
sop: Compute the quarter movement in ceded reserves by treaty.
Write the driver commentary for each material movement.
Done when every material movement carries commentary.
verify: Filter material movements for missing commentary.
Pass when every material movement carries commentary.

steps.title: Agree the reported balances to the ledger and reinsurance system
sop: Compare the reported ceded balances to the general ledger.
Compare them to the reinsurance system ceded balances.
Done when both comparisons are complete.
verify: Recompute both differences.
Pass when the reported balances agree to both sources.

steps.title: Include the collectability and bad-debt provision summary
sop: Add the collectability conclusions and bad-debt provision summary.
Confirm the provision figures match the provision schedule.
Done when the summary is included in the report.
verify: Compare the summary to the provision schedule.
Pass when the summary agrees to the provision schedule.

steps.title: Publish the report to the BI reporting platform
sop: Publish the ceded reserve report to the BI reporting platform.
Confirm the published figures match the source workbook.
Done when the report is published.
verify: Compare published figures to the source workbook.
Pass when the published figures match the workbook.

steps.title: Distribute the report through Microsoft 365 SharePoint
sop: Upload the report to the SharePoint quarterly reporting folder.
Record the distribution date and the recipient list.
Done when the report is distributed and logged.
verify: Read the distribution log entry for the quarter.
Pass when the distribution date and recipients are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Bad-debt provision for uncollectible reinsurance recoverables by reinsurer.
generic.In-scope period: Recoverable balances outstanding at the reporting date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rating, status, collateral and provisioning rate populated per reinsurer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Provision balance agrees to the collectability assessment schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Provision calculation saved with the reporting date and matrix version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Provision overrides are logged with the approval reference.
generic.Test population: Every reinsurer carrying a recoverable balance at the reporting date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the posted provision lacks the required approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Amounts outside the authority matrix are escalated for higher approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Collateral held is offset before the provision rate is applied.
generic.Evidence location: Provision calculation and ERP entry reference in the close folder.

steps.title: Load the collectability schedule into the provision workbook
sop: Load the collectability assessment schedule into Microsoft Excel.
Confirm every reinsurer with a balance is present.
Done when the schedule is loaded for every reinsurer.
verify: Compare the loaded list to the reinsurance system balances.
Pass when every reinsurer with a balance is loaded.

steps.title: Apply the documented provisioning matrix by reinsurer
sop: Apply the documented provisioning rate for each reinsurer category.
Apply higher rates to unauthorised, unrated, downgraded and disputed balances.
Done when a provisioning rate is applied to every balance.
verify: Compare applied rates to the provisioning matrix.
Pass when every applied rate matches the matrix.

steps.title: Offset collateral held before provisioning
sop: Offset letters of credit, funds withheld and trusts against the balances.
Apply the provisioning rate to the net exposure.
Done when collateral is offset for every secured balance.
verify: Recompute a sample net exposure after collateral offset.
Pass when the sampled recomputation matches the calculation.

steps.title: Obtain approval under the provision authority matrix
sop: Identify the approval level required for the provision amount.
Obtain and record the approval before posting.
Done when the required approval is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded approval to the authority matrix.
Pass when the approval level meets the matrix requirement.

steps.title: Post the provision entry in the ERP general ledger
sop: Post the provision entry with the calculation attached.
Record the GL document number in the close folder.
Done when the provision entry is posted and referenced.
verify: Look up the posted document and read the attachment.
Pass when the entry is posted with the calculation attached.

steps.title: Reconcile the provision balance to the collectability schedule
sop: Compare the posted provision balance to the collectability schedule.
Investigate and clear any difference.
Done when the provision balance equals the schedule.
verify: Recompute the posted-to-schedule difference.
Pass when the difference is zero.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded reserves and recoverables against ledger and settlement statements.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period settlement and accounting cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, balance type, source amount and reconciling category per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reinsurance system balances agree to the general ledger receivables.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation saved with period, source extract dates and reviewer.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reconciling items above threshold are logged, aged and owned.
generic.Test population: Every ceded reserve and recoverable balance in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any item above threshold is unexplained between GL and system.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved items are escalated to Finance before period close.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Settlement statements and account current are reconciled for the period.
generic.Evidence location: Reconciliation workbook in the reinsurance close folder for the period.

steps.title: Reconcile actuarial ceded reserves to the reinsurance system
sop: Compare the actuarial ceded reserve summary to the reinsurance system balances.
List differences by treaty.
Done when a comparison exists for every treaty.
verify: Recompute the actuarial-to-system difference by treaty.
Pass when differences are zero or listed as reconciling items.

steps.title: Reconcile recoverables to the ERP accounts receivable balances
sop: Extract the reinsurance receivable balances from the general ledger.
Compare them to the reinsurance system recoverable balances.
Done when the comparison covers every receivable balance.
verify: Recompute the system-to-ledger difference.
Pass when no unexplained difference above threshold remains.

steps.title: Reconcile to settlement statements in the ceded accounting platform
sop: Load the reinsurer settlement statements and account current for the period.
Compare them to the recorded balances and billings.
Done when every statement is reconciled for the period.
verify: Compare statement balances to the recorded billings.
Pass when the statement balances reconcile for the period.

steps.title: Investigate and clear items above the agreed threshold
sop: Apply the agreed threshold to each reconciling item.
Clear or explain every item above the threshold.
Done when no item above threshold is left open.
verify: Filter the reconciliation for open items above threshold.
Pass when the filter returns no open item.

steps.title: Age the remaining reconciling items in the workbook
sop: Age each remaining reconciling item from its origination date.
Assign an owner and target closure date to each.
Done when every remaining item carries an age and an owner.
verify: Scan the workbook for items with no owner or age.
Pass when every remaining item carries an owner and an age.

steps.title: Obtain reviewer sign-off before period close
sop: Review the completed reconciliation and the open item log.
Record the reviewer name and date on the workbook.
Done when the reconciliation carries a reviewer sign-off.
verify: Read the sign-off block on the workbook.
Pass when reviewer name and date are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: External audit requests relating to reinsurance recoverables.
generic.In-scope period: The audit cycle covering the current reporting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each request records owner, due date, response and release date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Responses provided match the requests on the audit PBC list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Responses retained with the release date and reviewer name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Audit findings on recoverables are logged and tracked to closure.
generic.Test population: Every audit request on the recoverables PBC list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any request remains open past its agreed due date.
generic.Exception handling path: At-risk requests are escalated to the Reinsurance Actuary before the due date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each response is reviewed for accuracy before release to the auditor.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint audit folder with responses indexed to the PBC list.

steps.title: Track recoverable audit requests on the PBC list in SharePoint
sop: Load the external audit requests for recoverables onto the PBC list.
Assign an owner and due date to each request.
Done when every request carries an owner and due date.
verify: Filter the PBC list for requests with no owner or due date.
Pass when every request carries an owner and due date.

steps.title: Provide the ceded calculation and treaty mapping to the auditor
sop: Retrieve the ceded reserve calculation and treaty mapping requested.
Prepare the response pack for release.
Done when the requested documents are prepared.
verify: Compare the prepared pack to the request wording.
Pass when the pack covers everything requested.

steps.title: Provide the collectability assessment from the reinsurance system
sop: Retrieve the collectability assessment for the reporting period.
Add it to the audit response pack.
Done when the assessment is included in the pack.
verify: Compare the included assessment to the released period version.
Pass when the included version matches the released version.

steps.title: Provide the recoverable reconciliations to ledger and statements
sop: Retrieve the reconciliation of recoverables to the ledger and statements.
Add it to the audit response pack.
Done when the reconciliations are included.
verify: Check the included reconciliation for reviewer sign-off.
Pass when the included reconciliation carries a sign-off.

steps.title: Review each response before release to the auditor
sop: Review each response for accuracy and completeness.
Record the review and release date in the document repository.
Done when every response is reviewed before release.
verify: Read the review record on each released response.
Pass when every released response carries a review record.

steps.title: Log audit findings and track remediation to closure
sop: Log every audit finding on recoverables with an owner and due date.
Track each remediation action to closure.
Done when every finding carries an owner and a tracked action.
verify: Filter the findings log for open items past their due date.
Pass when no request or finding is open past its due date.
